requiredFindings.problem: The derived ceiling still omits required constituents of the coverage key. CoverageKeyV1 and C-2 coverageKey.key require relation, resolution and schemaVersion beside the members the Analyze rows list. CoverageKeyV2, the returned key, requires relation and resolution beside sourceUniverse, targetUniverse and subjectScopeCommitment. ViewEntryV3 requires relation and resolution as well. NE:3279-3281 says relation, resolution and subjectScopeCommitment equal the requested key, and that the request key's producer, producerVersion and schemaVersion stay request coordinates. The rules admit producer and producerVersion and omit relation, resolution and schemaVersion, so the ceiling's "exactly these members" is short of the key the cited contracts define.
requiredFindings.evidence: DLV CoverageKeyV1 required fields are relation, resolution, sourceUniverseId, targetUniverseId, subjectScopeCommitment, producer, producerVersion and schemaVersion, and its join says it is the field-for-field coverageKey.key (DLV:804-817). C-2 coverageKey.key lists the same eight fields (c2-plan-stage-schema.v3.json coverageKey.key). CoverageKeyV2 required fields are relation, resolution, sourceUniverse, subjectScopeCommitment and targetUniverse. ViewEntryV3 requires relation and resolution. R1 admits only the Id, Key, Commitment, Sha256, Digest, Hash, MerkleRoot, Closure and Universe suffixes, so relation, resolution and schemaVersion miss it. Their descriptions ("requested live relation", "live rung for that relation", "uint64; exactly 1", "the Coverage record's own shape") name no identity type and no R1 member, so R4 and R5 do not fire. The returned key is JSON Schema, and walk_json classifies only by R2, R1 and R6. L-C1 exits 0 and therefore reproduces the omission. The same rules do admit the members r3 named: subjectScopeCommitment on the key, stageId, Rust subjectId, anchor factId, the split custody ids, and analysisOrdinal and phase in the non-identity column.
requiredFindings.fix: In the closed rule set, every required member of DLV CoverageKeyV1, of C-2 coverageKey.key, and of CoverageKeyV2 is identity-bearing, and so are ViewEntryV3.relation and ViewEntryV3.resolution. Apply that in the prose walker and in walk_json. The Analyze requested-key rows then include relation, resolution and schemaVersion. The Coverage, post-Analyze Unavailable and BudgetExhausted rows then include key.relation, key.resolution, entry.relation and entry.resolution, in both languages. State the same rule in item 13. Regenerate the table and evidence/wire-identities.json from the script. Leave the other R1-R6 admissions as they are.
